data.mode: live: list snapshots must be recorded weekly (later downloads drop delisted coins)
data.source: public keyless perp endpoints: Binance USDT-M outside the 30, Bybit linear, Hyperliquid (funding history and daily klines)
data.universe: every perp listed at each weekly decision, delisted ones kept

note: Value = the book's weekly return after costs and funding. Effect is the train Sharpe, the optimistic number; the held-out year was -0.65. Adapter needed: carry3.py stops at TRAIN_END/HELD_END.

params.band: a held coin stays until it leaves its half of the ranking; small weight changes are not traded
params.costs: carry-3 model: ~8 bps a side (5 fee, 1.5 half-spread, 1.5 impact) plus every funding payment
params.long: third of perps with the lowest funding
params.short: third of perps with the highest funding

source: carry-3 (PR #31): train 2021-02..2025-11 pooled Sharpe 0.79 (p 0.025); held-out 2025-11..2026-11 -0.65 (failed, year spent); rl-6 (PR #52): ~7 years at p < 0.10
status: proposed by lane forward-1 on 2026-11-18; NOT frozen by the owner

data.calendar: federalreserve.gov FOMC meeting calendar, scheduled meetings only
data.source: TLT daily bars (Yahoo chart; raw close plus dividends on ex-dates)

note: sd 107 bps = 26.5 / 2.3 * sqrt(87), from ann-1's cell. Effect is the papers' 12 bps; at ann-1's 26.5 it would need ~16 years. Descriptive close-to-close; the gym could only trade open-to-open. Adapter needed: ann1_event.py stops at 2025-11-09.

params.value: TLT dividend-adjusted return close(day -1) to close(day 0), minus the mean TLT daily return over the 250 trading days before day -1 that are not FOMC days; bps

source: survey-2 S3 (Pan and Peng 2025; Hillenbrand, RFS 2025): ~12 bps a meeting; ann-1 (PR #65): TLT day 0 +26.5 bps over other days 2015-2025 (t 2.3, 87 meetings, in the papers' own sample, 1 of ~70 cells)
status: proposed by lane forward-1 on 2026-11-18; NOT frozen by the owner

data.source: Coin Metrics community data, breadth-1's top-100 coin book, dead coins kept

note: 21 episodes in ~13 years = 1.6 a year, but only 7.6 effectively independent in 10 years: by that count the years needed double. A risk choice (shallower worst loss, same Sharpe), so the forward test cannot settle the owner's decision in time.

params.compare: a cap on the coin slot of matched cost (0.663 of the slot)
params.episode: a coin of breadth-1's top-100 book falls 60% or more; falls grouped into episodes as in coin-cap-2
params.rule: stop-0.25 on the coin slots of tsmom12, checked weekly
params.value: cap's deepest loss minus the stop's deepest loss in the episode (> 0: the stop wins)

source: coin-cap-2 (PR #53): stop ahead of the matched cap in 15 of 21 episodes 2013-2025 (sign p 0.039); coin-cap-3 (PR #56): not significant against all 13 coin-cap picks
status: proposed by lane forward-1 on 2026-11-18; NOT frozen by the owner

data.source: Yahoo chart UCITS lines in EUR (eu-1's set)

note: Effect 0.50 = the annual signal-to-noise of the difference implied by p 0.03 over ~14 years (z 1.88 / sqrt(14)). Probably inflated (best of six). The fee saving of a monthly clock is mechanical and needs no forward test; only the edge does.

params.a: V1: signal checked and trades placed only on the last Friday of each month
params.b: R: house rule (Friday signal, weights repeated daily, 1% band)
params.book: euw: SXR8, EXSA, IQQE, IBGS, IBGL, 4GLD, EXXY
params.value: weekly return of a minus weekly return of b, EUR, no fixed fee

source: eu-3 (PR #63): monthly +0.14 Sharpe over weekly at no fee, one-sided bootstrap p 0.03 over 2012-2025 (best of 6 variants; on the US six 1994-2025 monthly was worse)
status: proposed by lane forward-1 on 2026-11-18; NOT frozen by the owner
